p.t: Acapulco Shore (ENG): What I Leave and What I Take
p.d: The vacation has come to an end and the Shores say goodbye without knowing if they will ever be together again, but they're sure that they had an unforgettable vacation.

The holidays begin and on the first day in the Shore house, old and new members meet to start a holiday of madness. The return to the original house seems to have an effect on its inhabitants and new romances.

After a wild first night, the Shore house decides to spend a quiet afternoon on the beach where they take the opportunity to talk about what happened the previous night and get to know each other better.

The new Boss arrives at the house and the Shores discover that their duties are not at all similar to what they expected. After a day of work, there's nothing better than a few drinks and what seemed like a quiet party, ends in a crazy night.

After Fernando’s accident, Potro decides to accompany him to the hospital and the consequences of his fall are not long in coming. Once again, the Boss arrives at the house to send the Shores to a new job.
It’s a new day at the Shore house and the arrival of the Boss excites almost every member of the house. As night falls, the Shore family decides to go somewhere quieter.

A Colombian guest arrives at the Shore house, while Fernando leaves Acapulco to see his doctor to decide if he can finish his family vacation. Everything is ready for the initiation of new members for the house.

Erick arrives at the Shore house and immediately begins flirting with one of the new members. The party begins and the wives decide to spend the day handcuffed. Finally, the new members are initiated.
Cintia is less and less able to take the attitude of the midwives and decides to end her vacation. Once again, the Boss arrives and announces that the next job is going to be in Chihuahua.
The Shore family continues to enjoy their trip to Chihuahua. Erick feels more and more pressure to take an ugly girl to bed, which Leslie is upset about.

For some inmates, the only way out of prison is paroling legit, or leaving in a body bag; others earn a lump sum of good time by completing programs or holding a prison job, while a few will take any chance to try to escape.

A repeat offender smuggles in contraband and an inmate becomes a marked man after murdering a Louisville rap star; a prescription pill epidemic takes its toll on the jail and drug use on the inside could keep another inmate from leaving.

The killer of a corrections officer fights to be freed from 16 years of solitary confinement, and boyhood friends struggle to parent their kids from behind prison walls; but one, cut-off from visits with his son, is on a razor's edge.

Ari and David clash about Derek's growing involvement in David's campaign. Unable to track down Hazel's pre-nup, Ari, Hazel, and Bree orchestrate a heist into Derek's penthouse to steal his copy of their pre-nup. Bree serves Gary with divorce papers.

Ari is pissed when a scandalous video of her daughter, Megan, is leaked. Bree faces the reality of life without Gary when he becomes less available. Hazel is forced to sell off her prized possessions to help with her financial situation.
The nouveau riche Johnsons make a splash in the luxurious town of Sag Harbor, where a face-off with the storied Britton family over a coveted piece of property sparks an intense feud.
The Johnsons continue to pose a serious threat to the Brittons, and Carolyn enlists the help of her daughter-in-law to enact some salacious strategies to get one over on the new neighbors.
In desperate need of her next hit, gospel queen and record executive Denita Jordan reaches a career crossroads when her son Taj endorses a traumatized rising star with a risqué reputation.
Taj goes against the family and brings a reluctant Rbel to meet his mother's rival Caesar at Redeeming Records, spurring a disaster during Denita's lifetime achievement award tribute.
Joan becomes more adventurous with her boyfriend Chris, but inadvertently takes Ecstasy at a club with him and has a bad trip that puts her into the hospital.
Toni is frantic as the grand opening of her real estate agency is less than a week away.

Joan ends the friendship between her and Toni after finding out that Toni has been discussing her personal life with co-workers behind her back. Meanwhile, Lynn is trying to cope with her new living situation with Vosco, and his lack of a job.
Eddie's new band jeopardizes his work at the garage.
A TV commercial inadvertently turns Malcolm McGee's into a gay bar.
When Eddie buys a new couch, he doesn't have enough money to pay the rent.
A mistakenly delivered love letter spawns romantic confusion at McGee's.
Malcolm, Eddie and their friends are stranded during their employee picnic and retreat.
After refusing an offer of a buyout, a big tow truck operator destroys Eddie's business.

Mark's stubborn attempts to fix the plumbing fail miserably.
Mark has to go clean his grandfather's cabin, and he and Geneva realize they have different memories of the place. MARK CURRY plays a dual role as Mark and his grandfather.
Geneva and Vanessa move out when Mark treats them poorly, but he soon learns what it feels like.
Mark uses Vanessa's medical shoulder brace to get sympathy from a beautiful woman, but the charade gets out of control.
A trip to a nostalgic tree farm is ruined for Mark and his friends until they all learn the true meaning of Christmas.
Earvin is challenged by a gang member, and Mark intervenes. Raven appears in this episode.

Written, directed and starring Chris Rock, TOP FIVE tells the story of New York City comedian-turned-film star Andre Allen, whose unexpected encounter with a journalist forces him to confront the comedy career—and the past—that he’s left behind.

When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

Fed up with the establishment profiting from Black entertainment that relies on offensive tropes, a frustrated novelist decides to write an outlandish Black book of his own, one that propels him to the heart of the hypocrisy he disdains.

In an unflinching look at the mean streets of the contemporary urban American ghetto, a Black youth—despite his dreams for a better life—ultimately succumbs to the cycle of violence that pervades his community.

A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. And Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

Jody is a 20-year-old African American in South Central L.A. who is trying to live large but doesn't have a job. Growing up is tough on Jody, but a series of events force him to learn lessons about living, loving and surviving as a man in the hood.

Hoss finds a kindred spirit in Skeeter Dexter, a lonesome young man who feels closer to animals than most people.
The Pony Express sets up office in Virginia and Joe is one of the first to join up. Ben also decides to invest in the fledgling enterprise.
In this series' highlight, little Michael Thorpe heads to the high country to ask God to spare his critically wounded father, believing he has found Him in the form of longtime fugitive Tom Cain.
A young troubadour, who blames Ben for the death of his father, returns to Virginia City. In one scene, Ben says the young man is welcome to use Adam's guitar.
When Hoss is responsible for causing a hung jury, Ben tells him, a man is never wrong doing what he thinks is right, and Adam attempts to validate his brother's reasonable doubt.
After sitting on a jury that has convicted Terrence O' Tool of murder, Joe has second thoughts about the verdict and decides to do some investigating of his own.

Two robberies take place on stagecoaches that Adam is traveling on, and both times a knight in shining armor scares the robbers away. Adam is accused of robbery, and his story about the knight is none too helpful.

MacGyver uncovers an illegal trading ring dealing in counterfeit baseball memorabilia.
An ex-girlfriend frames MacGyver for her broadcasting magnate husband's murder.
MacGyver fights plans for a housing development in an ecologically delicate area.

Mark and Steve return home from a fishing trip to a shocking discovery - the bloody and beaten body of Mickey, the young medical student who, along with his wife Jill, also a medical student, had been house-sitting for them.
Steve reluctantly goes on a dating game show and wins. Much to his pleasnat surprise, his date appears to be everything he's looking for and more.
Steve gets an unexpected phone call from Hawk, an old friend from the police force who has recently retired and moved into the Sunny Meadows rest home.
Marine Lt. Hank Thomas enters BBQ Bob's, the favorite lunchtime hangout of the doctors, wielding a gun in his left hand and threatening three other Marines who are already there.
Paraplegic, asthmatic game show contestant Sol Singer climbs into his specially-modified van and sets out to a TV studio where he is bout to compete on the live quiz show Through the Roof.
Dear friend and famous pop singer Danielle Marsh comes from new York to stay with Mark and Steve while she prepares for a big comeback conecrt.
The murder of a young woman brings Alex into contact with her roommate Amy Saroyan, Alex's former girlfriend whom he has not seen in many years.
While a deliriously happy Madison helps new love Brett Hayward move in with her, Steve investigates the brutal slaying of palastic surgeon Dr. Yordsberg.
Roger and Lana's marriage is rocky at best. Lana plots for her lover to kill Roger while he is away for the night on business so that she can have all of his money.
When fellow workers at a labor camp nickname Richard Kimble Doc it prompts three criminals, who have kidnapped a boy, to draft him into service when the boy is hurt.
Richard Kimble is forced to defy hurricane warnings to transport a couple from the mainland to the Florida Keys.

Walter is in the depths of despair after losing his appliance store to bankruptcy, and Maude's efforts to improve his mental disposition result in disaster.
An apprehensive Maude visits Walter the day after his suicide attempt, and learns of some complications that may delay his return home, on the conclusion of a three-part episode.

On the eve of the national elections, Maude has far greater worries than the fate of her candidate, when she is introduced to Carol's latest boyfriend. Maude's negative reaction sets off a battle with Carol, but the worst news about Lee is yet to come.
An unwilling Maude reluctantly agrees to go on a game show with Vivian, only to have her attempts at keeping Vivian from making a fool of herself backfire.
Walter has had a very unusual dream involving Arthur and when Arthur finds out, he panics at the thought of spending the weekend alone with Walter.

When an ill woman tells Edith to let her die with dignity at the SunShine Home, the woman's family are furious after her death. The manager fires Edith for her selfishness, even though Edith honoured the woman's wish.

Louise Jefferson returns for a visit at the Bunker's place to ask Edith if she can sell her (Louise's) former house. Edith doubts but Archie makes her agree so that they (mostly he) can choose white people to move in.

When Archie's brother, Fred, visits Archie to open up a business, he also brings his 18 year old wife, Katherine. Both, Archie and Edith, and even Stephanie, are shocked as they find out. Archie and Fred argue about Katherine's age.
Stephanie's father, Floyd, finally arrives with a devastating proposition for the Bunkers: They can keep Stephanie if they agree to pay him $1000 cash!

When Cousin Liz dies, Edith and Archie learn more about her than they ever thought. When a roomate of Liz, Veronica, comes out of the closet to Edith, she also admits that she was more than just roomates with Liz.

Archie must delay his weekend fishing trip with Barney when Edith announces that she has invited people from the SunShine Home to attend an elderly couple's wedding at 704 on the same day Archie planned to leave.
When Kelsey finally decides to sell his bar, nothing will stop Archie from getting it--even if it means forging Edith's signature against her will.
Edith is upset when she discovers Archie has forged her signature to get the bar. But Mike will influence Mrs. Bunker to change her mind.
Mama and Iola have a huge fight when Iola discovers the Harpers are selling her handicrafts behind her back at their garage sale.

When Mama is almost struck by lightning and nearly loses her life, she feels reborn. The Harper family takes full advantage of her new attitude, but whether they can handle it or not remains to be seen.

p.t: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125
p.d: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven's final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125.
Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Música del Palacio de Mineria.

p.t: Piano Duets -- Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o
p.d: Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff and Nikolai Kapustin.

p.t: Walton: Viola Concerto And Brahms: Symphony No. 4
p.d: Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Brahms's Symphony No. Four; Antoine Tamestit continues his Artist Portrait.
Things change for a middle-class couple (Alan Alda, Carol Burnett) and two other couples they vacation with four times a year.

p.t: Gaming X Symphony: Legends And Quests in Concert
p.d: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, with Nordic singer Eivør as special guest in Legends Never Die and more.
The Youth Wunderhorn (Magic Horn) songs represent an important aspect of Mahler's engagement with the romantic tradition, even as they pave the way for his more famous symphonic works.

Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

p.t: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36
p.d: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. Recorded at La Cité de la musique in Paris in 2016.

p.t: Grieg's Piano Concerto And Beethoven Symphony No. 7
p.d: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium; Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebrides, Op. 26; Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16.

The body of Lori Nesson is found in a ditch in 1974, yet her death is not ruled a homicide. After four decades, the cause of death is changed to homicide, and the search begins for a killer.
Our cameras follow Detective Manny Reyes as he investigates the 1990 murder of a Fort Worth, Texas woman. Reyes talks to the woman's two sons, who believe that her husband, Bobby, was the murderer.

In late 1983, the bodies of five people abducted from a local fast food restaurant are found brutally murdered. The main suspect is long believed to be a well-connected local man, until new evidence reveals the true killers.
In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.
When 18-year-old Shannon Siders' body is found in the woods, everyone in the small town of Newaygo, Michigan, becomes a suspect--but no one is convicted of the crime.
The murder of an Ohio woman in 1974 is solved more than 20 years later after police get a crucial clue--the woman's husband was seen building a coffin-shaped box about the time the woman disappeared.
A Texas woman's murder is finally solved when the killer's plan to kill a second woman and stuff her into a duffel bag goes awry.
A bloody dagger and a phone tap help detectives solve a 20-year-old murder case. And DNA taken from an eyelash found on a dead prostitute's body brings a killer to justice.
The case of a gruesome stabbing death of a bullied teenager remains unsolved for 27 years.

After U.S. Navy sailor disappears in 68, the Navy claims he went AWOL. But his sister works for over 30 years to prove that he was really killed. And DNA from a cigarette butt helps detectives to unravel a 20-year-old case of rape and murder.

On a summer night in 1987, a 17-year-old girl to come home is found raped and strangled near the Hudson River. And In 1983, a young mother is raped and murdered at work. The crime remains unsolved for two decades.

While hiking with husband Dennis in Montana, Leslee Larson fell into Wolf Creek. Then Dennis is convicted of murdering his wife, while in Main. And 15-year-old papergirl Penny Parker goes missing, then her body is found by a search volunteer.

A videotape made at an ATM machine helps police in Louisville, KY, to nab a man suspected of raping 13 women. And a DA investigator in Georgia helps crack a murder case that his father, a police chief, first worked on 30 years before.

In 1979 Janie Landers disappears from a home for the impaired--the latest consequence of the facility's history of neglect. When Janie's body is found, there are many suspects but it is years before the killer is found.

The Reno Sheriff's Department lavishes attention on Wiegel after her failed suicide attempt, and Williams and Garcia hook up.
The guys hit a strip club to celebrate Garcia's 15-year anniversary on the force.
The Office of Homeland Security teaches the Reno Sheriff's Department terrorist attack protocol, and Clemmy's mom gets into trouble.
Dangle needs help moving out of his house, and Junior teaches Reno's youth about prison life.
The Reno Sherriff's Department passes their Homeland Security exam with flying colors, and Clemmy and a drunk driver discover some new moves.

The boys are transformed into Japanese Warriors after they trick a vendor and buy martial arts weapons at a local flea market.

Deputies tackle a man who shoots himself during a tense alley encounter. Officers confront a man exposing himself in an apartment window. Deputies trade crime for comedy while tracking a missing cow.
Officers subdue a combative reveler during Pioneer Days. Deputies help a man in crisis get treatment. Detectives stop a suspect transporting kilos of cocaine before he suffers a medical emergency.
A pursuit suspect ditches his gun. Officers calm an armed senior after shots ring out during a burglary scare. Deputies catch a passenger lying to dodge an active warrant.
Kansas City cops handle a chaotic yard brawl and chase down a wanted suspect. Officers respond to a bizarre assault at an auto salvage yard. A suspect runs after smashing motel windows.
Officers handle a horrific crash and stop suspects fleeing a drive-by. Narcotics detectives seize guns and a Corvette. An angry, toothless suspect is arrested after a violent family dispute.
Officers chase down a teen accused of stealing a camper top. Officers arrest an abusive husband. Deputies move cows out of a graveyard before returning to a home plagued by ongoing domestic violence.
K9 captures a robbery suspect on the run. Officers arrest a man after a bizarre fight over a five-cent banana. Detectives discover a stabbing victim may have injured himself.
A cocaine ring investigation snowballs into multiple takedowns through informants and setups. Deputies respond to a motel stabbing where stories shift about how the husband was wounded.
Police chase a stolen Jeep until the driver bails and resists arrest. Deputies subdue a combative domestic suspect amid family chaos. A raid uncovers an illegal still and a weed grow in a kid's room.
Police chase a car with a broken window. Beach patrol officers deal with colorful characters, including a woman mistaking a cop for her husband. A raid uncovers guns, boobytraps, and fake cash.
A disoriented man fighting deputies says spies are chasing him. A domestic involving a woman's many ex-husbands. A narcotics raid uncovers guns and marked drug money in a suspect's fridge.
Deputies detain a disorderly prowler making strange claims. Officers investigate suspicious credit card use at a gas station. A driver abandons his truck after smashing into a pole.
A window-smashing burglary suspect is caught after a struggle. A plane crash at Sky Harbor. An injured hit-and-run driver hides at home. Officers break up a dispute between feuding brothers.
A welfare check turns tense when shots are fired. Officers investigate a fight at a pizza shop linked to a relationship dispute. Narcotics detectives arrest a woman accused of selling meth.
A traffic stop uncovers meth, a gun, and kids riding unrestrained. Meth is found taped to a suspect's shirt. An estranged husband woos his wayward wife with promises of shrimp and smokes.

Michael Jackson's personal doctor Conrad Murray takes an oath to first do no harm, but that's exactly what prosecutors argue he violates when Jackson dies from an overdose of a powerful anesthesia drug.

Rebecca Schaeffer was talented, pretty, and had her whole life ahead of her when she unknowingly opened the door of her Hollywood apartment to her killer Robert Bardo; Bardo's lawyers say his mental illness caused him to snap.

Rabbi Fred Neulander was a pillar of his Cherry Hill, New Jersey community -- the founder of a synagogue, a father and a husband; little did anyone know, he was also an adulterer, one capable of hiring a hitman to murder his own wife.
A football coach serves nine years in prison for the murder of his wife before a Texas Court of Criminal Appeals finds he didn't get a fair trial.
Authorities first suspect the husband in the savage murder of a Florida doctor, but when he has an alibi, they follow a tip on a 1,100-mile trip that takes the case in an unexpected direction.
When a 17-year-old girl breaks up with her abusive boyfriend, he snaps and breaks into her bedroom to attack her.
Twenty years after a Palm Beach socialite killed her husband, the same gun is used in another shooting in the family.
A Costa Rican paradise turns into a nightmare when a millionaire is found dead in his bedroom.
The investigation into the shooting death of retired NYPD officer Patrick Gilhuley, including interviews with jury members and a deconstruction of forensic evidence.
Twenty years after a Palm Beach socialite killed her husband, the same gun is used in another shooting in the family.
A Costa Rican paradise turns into a nightmare when a millionaire is found dead in his bedroom.
The investigation into the shooting death of retired NYPD officer Patrick Gilhuley, including interviews with jury members and a deconstruction of forensic evidence.
In Kansas City, Missouri, a woman falls for a hustler and pays a devastating price; in Castlerock, Northern Ireland, a dentist falls for a patient, and comes up with an unusual treatment plan.
In Westchester County, New York, a wife begins a fling with a co-worker which leads to an erotic game with a violent conclusion.
In Rocky Mount, North Carolina, a mortician falls in love in his funeral parlor; while in Mustang, Oklahoma, a sexual obsession turns deadly.
Un niño de 12 años es atacado en su hogar en Postdam, Nueva York.
Dos jóvenes caen en las redes del tráfico de personas y la prostitución.
Un joven cae preso por el asesinato de su esposa, pero el ADN no concuerda.
Una madre ayuda a la policía a resolver un caso arriesgando su vida.
Tras décadas, se reabre el caso del supuesto suicidio de una embarazada.
Un domingo de Pascua, Heidi Allen, de 18 años, desaparece de su trabajo.
Cuando una joven madre es asesinada, las pistas apuntan a una conspiración.
La fe de una mujer cristiana es puesta a prueba cuando se enamora.
Una mujer mantiene un romance peligroso con un ministro de la iglesia.
Un acto de caridad de una pareja cristiana trae consecuencias inesperadas.
Celos y sospechas invaden el amorío entre un marine y una mujer casada.
Una adolescente intenta mantener secreto su romance con un hombre mayor.
Un policía inexperto debe ocultar sus encuentros con una bailarina exótica.
Una adolescente hará lo que sea por ocultar su relación con un estudiante.
Una adolescente que quiere convertirse en policía se enamora de un oficial.
Garcia leading a victims' support group is a measure to deal with the guilt associated with the death of her parents when she was a teenager.
The suspicious deaths of two high school students in a small town lead Hotchner and the team to believe they were victims of a cult killing.
The daughter of high-powered diplomats must battle suspicions of nepotism when her assignment to the unit takes place without notification to Hotch or Gideon.

As the city is on high alert, the team begins to believe that they have made a mistake with the profile and that everything the terrorists have done so far may just have been a diversion for something even bigger.

The team faces opposition from the local law enforcement in charge of a murder investigation; when another victim is discovered, the two teams find a common ground and collaborate to identify the killer before further violence is perpetrated.
The team investigate bank robberies where victims were forced to undress during the ordeal. The robber's behavior begins to escalate from the search for profit to the abuse of captives.
The BAU team hit choppy waters on the beaches of Southern California when they discover a series of bodies hidden in lifeguard towers along the coast.
The team travels to Durant, Oklahoma, where two females - both low risk in their late teens, long blond hair and blue eyes - were found sexually assaulted then murdered within a three day span.

A killer with a number of identities leads the authorities on a baffling chase through the South; the Behavioural Analysis Unit has a tricky job on their hands as they attempt to profile the man beneath the rapidly changing exterior.
The team thinks that two people might be working together to commit a series of murders, taking leads from DVD footage of each crime provided by the families of the victims.

The BAU team investigates a mass murder at an Internet security company in Charlottesville, VA, but clues reveal it is not a typical serial killer at work. Also, Prentiss must complete recertification training under Morgan's watchful eye.
Male college students on spring break are being raped and murdered, presumably by a man and a woman working together. The BAU are called in and suspect a shy hotel cleaner and a receptionist.
The team gains a new, familiar, member and some growing pains while trying to find the latest victim of a killer who puts up wanted posters of his victims before he abducts them.
An AMBER alert is activated for a young boy in Cherry Hill, New Jersey and the BAU suspect it to be the work of a pedophile who has abducted and killed two other boys.

Miri's daycare holds a field day.
Kazuki and Rei reconsider their guardianship of Miri.
Kazuki and Rei are adjusting to life without Miri.

Un obstetra regresó a casa del hospital y encontró a su esposa en el piso del baño. Estaba cubierta de sangre y no respiraba.

Una peluquera joven y atractiva fue agredida sexualmente y asesinada en su propio salón de belleza. La evidencia en la escena del crimen no coincidió con ninguno de los sospechosos y, después de la investigación inicial, el caso se archivó por diez años.
En 1989, los cadáveres de Joan Rogers y sus dos hijas adolescentes fueron encontrados flotando en la Bahía de Tampa.

p.t: Crímenes imperfectos: Un embrague de testigos
p.d: Dos testigos presenciales pueden tener la llave de la muerte de un miembro de una pandilla de motociclistas.
Un pirómano en serie anda suelto en Washington, DC. Cada uno de los incendios se inició con el mismo tipo de dispositivo incendiario.
La investigación de un choque mortal en 1983 causado por el equipo de seguridad de la reina de Inglaterra durante una visita a California.

En 1996, la policía de Virginia Beach llegó al departamento de Makdessi para encontrar los cuerpos ensangrentados de Elise Makdessi y de Quincy Brown, un soldado de la Marina. ¿Pero era el amante de Elise o su agresor?
En 1993, Kathryn Bishop de 82 años es encontrada muerta en su hogar de Pennsylvania. Pequeñas pistas en el cuerpo de la víctima le dirán a la policía lo que pasó esa noche.

¿Qué tan desafortunado puede ser un hombre? Su esposa se quitó la vida y su novia de la universidad se suicidó de la misma manera catorce años antes. Los investigadores tuvieron que determinar si esto era solo una extraña coincidencia o dos asesinatos.

En una trágica jugada del destino, pocos días después de que la mujer vendiera su casa y se mudara a un modesto remolque, un incendio se llevó tanto el remolque como su vida. Pero la autopsia demostró que no fue un accidente.
¿Quién fue el delincuente sexual que asesinó a dos muchachos adolescentes en Nebraska? La clave para detenerlo sería la composición única de la cuerda basura que usó para amarrar a sus víctimas.
Cuando un policía fuera de servicio murió de un disparo, sus colegas oficiales estaban determinados a resolver el crimen.

Poco después del amanecer, se inicia un incendio en un contenedor de basura en Vancouver. Nadie ve al pirómano ni el fuego, que arde durante horas en el estacionamiento desolado. Pero hay más que basura en este contenedor en llamas.

En el 2004, la estudiante de enfermería Tamika Huston desapareció de su hogar en Spartanburg, Carolina del Sur. Una pista llevó a los detectives a su auto y encontraron una llave de una casa desconocida que podría ayudar a resolver el caso.
Un robo en medio de la noche, en una casa suburbana al borde del desierto de Las Vegas, revela un vertedero de cadáveres.
Una familia de 4, es brutalmente asesinada en su propia casa.
CSI determina que el suicidio de una joven madre fue en realidad un juego sucio.
Una parada de tráfico de rutina se convierte en una salvaje persecución policial por las calles de un gueto latino de Las Vegas.
La evidencia apunta a Sofía como la que disparó accidentalmente a otro oficial.
En la noche de Acción de Gracias, un hombre es encontrado muerto en un contenedor de basura detrás de un restaurante.
El hijo de seis años de una madre viuda es secuestrado en un parque local.

p.d: Cuando los pacientes de un psiquiatra son asesinados sistemáticamente, el equipo de CSI se ve obligado a seguir el juego Cluedo para atrapar al asesino.

p.d: Cuando descubren que la detective Lovato es una agente encubierta, el equipo de CSI investiga a la pandilla callejera latina en la que ella se infiltró.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Fantasmas del pasado (S9 Ep10)
p.d: El equipo de CSI de Nueva York investiga un bar clandestino inspirado en la década de 1920 cuando asesinan a uno de sus dueños y desaparecen 10.000 dólares.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Control P (S9 Ep11)
p.d: El equipo de CSI de Nueva York se enfrenta a un misterio desconcertante cuando dos víctimas diferentes están vinculadas por la misma arma poco común.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Mentiras piadosas (S9 Ep12)
p.d: Cuando un querido oficial de policía de Nueva York fuera de servicio fallece en un robo, el equipo de CSI usa el arte del interrogatorio para doblegar a sus sospechosos y llegar a la verdad.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: El edificio 913 (S9 Ep13)
p.d: El equipo de CSI investiga cuando encuentran a un hombre enmascarado al pie de un rascacielos de mala fama conocido por su historia de muertes misteriosas.

p.d: Cuando secuestran a un joven pizzero, el equipo de CSI de Nueva York debe determinar qué buscaban realmente los perpetradores.

p.d: New York must eliminate 5 men, but it's not that easy. At a pre-elimination cocktail party, things heat up as the men drink too much, fight and even bribe others to win over New York.

p.d: Now down to 15 men, New York invites the guys to a pond where they must prove their love by swimming to her and presenting her with a gift.

p.d: With 12 guys left, some of the boys play a prank on a few of the less popular men that keeps them up all night.

p.d: New York has barely wiped the morning out of her eyes when a fight breaks out between two of her boys. Although NY can be a tolerant person, violence is non-negotiable and she is faced with the tough decision to let a guy go.

p.d: After snitching, fighting, and spitting, and nearly getting eliminated, one man is the house enemy and anxiously waits for an opportunity to redeem himself.
New York surprises the guys with the return of one man. Another man is unhappy as his world is suddenly turned upside down and he literally fears for his life.

p.t: I Love New York: I Still Have Love for New York
p.d: New York invites the remaining six guys' exes to the house and this time, there's a special twist involved. She's bringing two of HER exes, Chance and Real, to help dig up some dirt on her guys.

p.t: I Love New York: Mind Games
p.d: With 5 guys left, New York wants to find out who's the most compatible with her and who's just plain crazy, when she takes the boys for a psych test.

Going back 25 million years to the time of the indricothere, which was the largest mammal ever to live on dry land, being seven metres high and weighing 15 tons! The only threat to an adult would have been the Hyaenodon which was the size of a rhino.

The beginnings of mankind can be traced back 3.2 million years to Ethiopia and the advent of Australopithecus, a type of ape which, like humans, was bipedal. These early members of the human family faced many dangers, including the sabre-toothed cat.

Scientists study the perfectly preserved remains of an adolescent allosaurus they call Big Al.

Dog takes the day off to try his hand at coaching, and assigns Tim and Leland to track down a dangerous fugitive on their own. Can the boys prove they can handle it?
Dog and his team fight the war on ice-crystal methamphetamine-on many fronts. They appear on a special anti-drug float in a parade. Then they go after bail-jumping Pana, a convicted drug dealer.

Christopher is barely 21, who already has a history of domestic abuse and assault, and now he's facing major time in a room without a view. This hunt won't be easy for Dog -- the leads are few, informers and family are not forthcoming.

Dog decides it's time to outfit the Da Kine crew with new SUVs. After a quick visit to their local dealership, they go after Jasmine, a woman whose criminal record includes over 37 arrests for everything from drug promotion to assault.

Dog knows very little about Peter, but what he does know, he doesn't like! Not only is he currently facing two counts of second degree sexual assault, about week ago, he dropped out of sight before missing his court date.
In between tracking down a potentially dangerous ex-con facing a five-year stretch in the big house, Leland is struggling to find time to train and compete for his first boxing match in years.

Dog goes on his a case, which involves Bobby, who's been on parole for three months pending sentencing on an assault charge. Bobby's girlfriend wants him back in jail, and Dog agrees that the Bobby needs to be behind bars.
It's Christmas day, and Dog sets out to nab Raymond, who robs to support his ice habit, and give him a little Christmas gift - shiny new handcuffs.
Dog is a rough, tough bounty hunter, but he's a softie at heart, as the two cases in this episode show.

Baby Lyssa's wedding is only three days away, but Dog is thinking about bounties, not bouquets. A hot bounty comes in and Dog wants to go on the hunt. When the ladies object, Dog explains his decision, We're a family of hunters, we need to hunt.
Dog is going to be the keynote speaker at the annual Profession Bail Agents convention in Las Vegas, but before he leaves he's got to clear two cases from his docket--Heidi and Stephanie.
A one-hour special that looks back at 2006, one of Dog's most tumultuous years, which has included the passing of Beth's father, Dog and Beth's wedding, the tragic death of Dog's daughter Barbara.

Dog and the boys are going after a fugitive with a $25,000 bond and a string of theft charges behind him. When the team hits his apartment, they find a boot print on the door, a souvenir of a police raid from only days earlier?

Beth buys Dog a shirt with an embroidered chicken, but Dog explains he only wears shirts with pictures of either Jesus or a Harley-Davidson. When it's time to go to work, the team goes after Necia, a fugitive with felony charges pending.

It's the day before Valentine's Day and love is in the air at Da Kine Bail Bonds--but not for Tapi who has failed to appear in court on theft charges. Dog's plan is to have Leland knock on Tapi's door with a Valentine's gift to draw her out.

Es el ministro y los generales quienes han llegado a la boca de la caverna, Guillermo hace un conteo regresivo para dar tiempo a que El Capo y sus secuaces se entreguen.
El Capo cava la tumba para su hijo Juan Carlos, pide que lo dejen sólo, se encuentra muy afectado. Perrys, Tato y Nancho se encuentran cavando la tumba donde reposará el cuerpo sin vida de Chemo
El presidente se haya pensativo por la llamada no identificada que entró a su celular personal, el mandatario pide que investiguen el número. Marcela se encuentra muy nerviosa.
Julieta se encuentra con el director de inteligencia, consigue llamar a Pedro Pablo y conversan sobre las nuevas circunstancias, El Capo le hace saber a su hija que esa misma noche piensa entregase.
En casa de Laura, Julieta conversa con su hermana Diana, las hijas de El Capo hablan acerca de su padre, recuerdan el día que escucharon la noticia que Pedro Pablo era considerado “el capo de capos”.
Valentina está reunida con Marcela Lievano en la cárcel, Marcela finalmente le confiesa por qué sostuvo una relación con León Jaramillo, Valentina le consulta a su amiga qué hacer con la grabación.
Luego de analizar las consecuencias de su decisión, el presidente ordena que el avión de la DEA se detenga, y se congele el trámite de extradición de El Capo.
Sin perder la oportunidad para poder vengarse, Chicote y Muelas planean atacar a los escoltas del Capo, antes de que él también sea recluido en esa misma cárcel.
Mientras Nacho finge estar muy mal, es atendido por los paramédicos que lo trasladan a una entidad hospitalaria. El hermano de El Capo aprovecha para desarmar a los guardias.
Por la gravedad de la confesión, Nancho le pide a Julieta absoluta discreción, pues en caso que Pedro Pablo se entere de la traición de su hermano, además que él es el padre de Fabián.
Valentina se encuentra muy asustada, pues descubre que no sólo está siendo seguida sino que los hombres que la vigilan se encuentran en su casa, la periodista teme por su hija.
Al llegar a su celda, Guillermo le cuenta a Tato que su hijo ha muerto. Tato queda muy afectado y llorando le pide perdón a Guillermo. Ofelia se encuentra destrozada por la muerte de Felipe.
Al terminar el sepelio de Felipe, Nacho se acerca a la inconsolable Julieta. Julieta le pregunta a su tío si no guarda rencor hacia Pedro Pablo por haberlo inducido al camino delincuencial.

In 1980, Michigan resident Shannon Mohr died in what her new husband, David Davis, reported to be a horseback riding accident. After her death, Shannon's family reported that Davis seemed far from grief-stricken.
A man dies in his home after a long history of heart disease. A few weeks after the funeral, rumors surface that the death was no accident.

A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.
In 1985, Julie Estes was kidnapped from the Southside convenience store where she worked. Her body was found the next day, but the killing went unsolved until 2003.
Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

Investigators are baffled after finding a murder scene devoid of any physical evidence, but they suspect that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If so, forensic scientists would have to find some way to learn what the dog had seen.

After a day of fishing in a quiet village in Switzerland, a teenage boy doesn't return home as planned. The investigation reveals some important microscopic evidence in the water near where he was last seen.
Prompted by news of a flight attendant's brutal murder, the son of a previous victim contacts police. Both murders have similar MOs, and biological evidence proves that these were serial killings.
A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.
After 6-year-old Michelle Lee Dorr went missing, her father confessed to murdering her. But investigators soon poked holes in his story, leaving the case unsolved for 14 years.
Lives changed in the 20 years following an unsolved murder, and so did forensic science. In time, a high-powered microscope and DNA profiling revealed a clue no one had seen before.
In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly toward TV crews covering the crime.
In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

Life magazine does a photo layout on the Ricardos and the only part of Lucy visible in the shot is her elbow. Lucy insists on getting a part in Ricky's act so that she can make a name for herself.
When Ricky cuts off Lucy's allowance and charge accounts because of her careless spending, Lucy finds herself short of funds. Ethel has tickets to a radio quiz show that has a cash prize of $1,000.

A movie contract for Ricky necessitates a change in scenery and the hanging of a for rent sign on the Ricardos' New York home. The Mertzes, willing to give up tenants but not friends, sign on for the trip.

Lucy hates the mustache that Ricky grows for a potential movie role and demands that he shave it off. When he refuses, Lucy gets a fake beard and glues it on her face. To teach Ricky a lesson, she kisses her husband with the beard on when he arrives home.
Lucy plays Cupid and tries to bag a bachelor for a husband-hungry girlfriend. Lucy organizes an evening to show her unmarried friends, Dorothy and Sam, how wonderful marriage is.

Ricky discovers a wad of cash in Lucy's purse and closet full of strange valuables and assumes they're all her ill-gotten gains. He doesn't realize Lucy has been legitimately collecting for her club's fundraising bazaar.
When Ben Benjamin arrives at the Ricardos' apartment, Lucy mistakes Ben Benjamin, a Hollywood talent scout, for a burglar and nearly ruins Ricky's chance for a film career.

The Tropicana club is about to re-open under new management and is looking to Ricky to put on the best possible show. The only problem is that Ricky has come down with a terrible case of laryngitis, and is unable to talk, much less sing.

Lucy feels that she and Ricky are growing apart because they don't share many of the same interests. To make up for this, Lucy decides to invite herself along to a camping trip that Ricky and Fred are going on.

The Ricardos' infant is cranky and keeps his parents as well as their neighbors up at night. When a neighbor, Mrs. Trumbull points out that the lease forbids children and threatens to move out along with other tenants.

Despite the reservations of her husband, Lucy decides to help Fred pick out a birthday present for Ethel. She picks out a pair of toreador pants, which Ethel thinks are unflattering as well as too big.

Lucy decides Ricky's love is growing cold so she takes Ethel's advice she learned from a book, How to Keep the Honeymoon from Ending. Her attempt to dress up for breakfast doesn't yield any response from Ricky.

Lucy and Ethel enter a contest for new home furnishings. If they are the lucky winner, they must be home the next day to receive a phone call. Unfortunately Ricky has four tickets to a new musical which he really wants to see.

Lucy learns that Ricky needs a dancer for his Parisian nightclub act and is determined to get the part. Fred offers to teach her how to dance but Ethel arranges instead to have the nephew of the woman who runs the French laundry to give pointers.

Lucy organizes an orchestra among her girlfriends, but it plays so horribly that she asks her bandleader husband, Ricky, to come to a rehearsal and give them some advice. His direction does little to help.

When Spencer accidentally sets fire to Carly's presents, she wishes that she had a normal brother. A Christmas angel shows Carly what her life would be like.

iKiss: Sam overhears Freddie confess to Carly that he's never kissed a girl, then exposes his secret on the webshow. Gibby and Carly train Spencer for a tryout with the local professional football team.

En 1999, la policía investigó dos asesinatos crueles en dos pequeñas ciudades a cientos de kilómetros de distancia.

Larry Horn casi se sale con la suya con el crimen perfecto: un complot de homicidio múltiple que había sido planeado y ejecutado meticulosamente. La exesposa de Horn, su hijo de ocho años y una niñera fueron asesinados de manera brutal por un homicida.
A principios de los años ochenta, la decapitación de un joven afroamericano llevó al Departamento de Policía de Miami-Dade y al FBI a lo largo de un rastro de asesinatos.
A principios de los 90, las bandas de drogas aterrorizaron Harlem, los vecindarios de Nueva York.
En 1992, una madre joven fue baleada frente a su hijo. La policía buscó respuestas, pero no encontró ninguna. El horrible crimen parecía carente de motivo y sentido, solo por azar.

El 12 de diciembre de 1998, dos personas armadas secuestraron a 3 bedeles que iban a hacer la limpieza en el almacén de cajeros automáticos de un banco en Las Vegas y los mantuvieron de rehenes después de ingresar a la instalación.

El 26 de febrero de 1993, una explosión sacudió el estacionamiento del Centro Mundial de Comercio. Seis personas murieron y más de mil resultaron heridas en la explosión que dejó un cráter de cinco pisos en el edificio.

Desde mayo hasta julio de 1984, Alton Coleman y su pareja de hecho, Denis Brown, se involucraron en una ola de asesinatos que atravesó seis estados y que dejó ocho personas muertas, entre ellos, niños.
Un día que comenzó con un paseo escolar al campo terminó con la peor pesadilla para los padres. Una niña de once años había desaparecido. Sus padres estaban seguros de que no se trataba de una huida.

El Alabama, un par de criminales condenados escaparon de la custodia de un oficial local y huyeron a lo largo del país. Mientras huían de las autoridades, fueron de estado en estado y desataron una ola de secuestros y robos de autos.
En el suroeste, un ladrón en serie de bancos afirmaba que su botín era para los pobres, pero este ladrón no era ningún héroe popular, pues tenía un arma y estaba dispuesto a disparar.

Jane and Rafael find themselves in a not ideal living situation in order to save money. When Rafael sees Alba try to punish Mateo, an unexpected rift is formed.
Jane believes she and Rafael are in a good place until she realizes he is keeping a secret from her. Alba's big day has finally arrived, and Jane, Xo and Rogelio are ready to celebrate.

Jane makes a shocking discovery and looks to Rafael for answers, but is confused by his decision to put everything they have on hold. Meanwhile, Petra is trying to secure a future with JR, but her past might jeopardize everything.

With Jane's Catholic guilt starting to settle in, she turns to Alba for advice and gets an unexpected answer. Luisa decides to go see Rose with Rafael by her side, in order to help get answers. Meanwhile, Rogelio is back to work with River.

Jane must get over the newest hurdle in her life, which proves to be harder than she hoped. Rogelio discovers that he and River are not as equal as he thought. Meanwhile, Jane and Petra must deal with the children not getting along.
After talking to everyone else about what is going on in her life, Jane turns to Petra, who she knows will give her a straight answer. In return, Petra leans on Jane for advice about JR.

Jane reluctantly agrees to let Rogelio throw her a big 30th birthday party. Jane's mentor gives her some important advice that may help her start writing again. Meanwhile, Petra thinks she and JR are finally in a good place.

Jane struggles with giving Rafael his space after she discovers that he is hiding a secret. Jane and Michael uncover clues about what happened the day he died. Petra wants to fit into JR's world and enlists Jane's help.

Jane is trying to go with the flow, so when Michael makes a suggestion that takes her out of her comfort zone, Jane decides to go for it. Jane struggles with her feelings for Raphael while Michael slides back into his old life.

Jane is having a hard time dealing with Rafael avoiding her, so when an issue with Mateo comes up she uses it to get some face time. Rogelio turns to Jane for help when he learns his pilot is in trouble.

When Jane and Rogelio join forces to pitch a pilot, Jane is excited until she discovers a secret about her book being published. Alba and Jorge make an important decision about their future together. Rafael asks Jane to allow Luisa to meet Mateo.
When Rogelio tells Jane that the network wants her to write the script for their telenovela, at first she is excited, but begins to struggle balancing her time between that and her novel.

With Jorge officially moved into Alba's house with his stuff, it quickly has changed the dynamic, making Jane to uncomfortable. Rafael and Jane work on their co-parenting of Mateo now that they have a potential way to help Mateo.

After Rafael witnesses Mateo's behavior at school, he wants to take a different approach to his treatment. Rogelio is paranoid that River is plotting her revenge against him. Meanwhile, Jane convinces Petra to go on a single ladies' night out.

Una hilarante parodia de A Christmas Carol, en la que al Abuelo se le aparecen fantasmas del pasado presente y futuro. Olaf es Timmy y Peluzin el fantasma.
Gaspar cansado de la ineficiencia y corrupción decide postularse como servidor público, mientras que Irma es grabada en una situación incómoda, convirtiéndose en una celebridad.
Pelúzín se roba un paquete de la puerta de Don Sebas, volteando a todo el edificio de cabeza, mientras Jonathan, cansado del bullying del Abuelo decide darle una lección.
LFDB decide hacerle una intervención al Abuelo porque está mas hostil que nunca y quieren que busque tratamiento médico, mientras que Peluzín y Jonathan ayudan a Pitipú a conseguir su nacionalidad.
Despúes de una ardua búsqueda el Noruego encuentra a su padre, mientras que Jonathan ayuda a Peluzín a llevar una vida de bien.
El Noruego decide recuperar a su antigua mascota tlacuache llamada Chofri, mientras que el Abuelo atraviesa por un lapso de demencia senil y depende de Gaspar salvarlo.
Un extraño bebé aparece en la puerta de LFDB, quien viene acarreando una ola de destrucción. Ahora la salvación del mundo depende de la Familia del Barrio.
El Abuelo consigue una ocupación donde se siente como pez en el agua, mientras que Peluzín entra en un proyecto experimental que le traerá muchos problemas a todos.
Gaspar encuentra por fin el amor de manera inesperada mientras que el Pasita, triste por las limitaciones de su edad avanzada consigue la receta para la eterna juventud.
Frustrado por su trabajo, Gaspar busca apoyo en el Abuelo y el Noruego y termina accidentado. Mientras, gracias a la medicina experimental, Peluzín se convierte en el Dr Lambretón.
Pelu el Payaso le pide a Jony que sea su nuevo ayudante e inician una gira espectacular que da muchos frutos. Mientras tanto, el Noruego descubre su afición por los tatuajes.
Peluzín adquiere una nueva mascota que revolucionará el vecindario. En tanto el Noruego y Gaspar intentan ayudar a el Lentejas a superar sus extrañas inclinaciones sexuales.
El Abuelo y el Noruego buscan nuevos horizontes a través de la creación de una fundación, mientras Peluzín cae en la cuenta de su soledad y sale a buscar amigos.
El Noruego aprende inglés y se prepara para vivir el sueño americano. En tanto, el Abuelo llega a un reencuentro con sus ex-compañeros de colegio y descubre una verdad sepultada por el tiempo.
Peluzín tiene éxito con un nuevo método de protesta, mientras El Noruego y Jony dan sus primeros pasos en la cossa nostra
Can trae noticias que dejan a Süreyya desconcertada.
Una sola fotografía desata una tormenta entre Süreyya y Faruk.
Akif toma una decisión audaz que deja a Senem sin palabras.
Adem se topa con una escena que le otorga una ventaja inesperada sobre los Boran.
Los planes con Emir terminan en desilusión, alejando aún más a Faruk y Süreyya.
Las decisiones imprudentes de Fikret finalmente lo alcanzan. Tras semanas de moverse en círculos peligrosos, queda acorralado por un golpe que nunca vio venir.
El temperamento de Faruk estalla al escuchar la noticia de Süreyya. Recorre la mansión como un hombre poseído, incapaz de contener su ira o su dolor.
Furioso y confundido, Emir actúa de una forma que deja a todos sin palabras. Su reacción expone las frágiles grietas emocionales que recorren la familia Boran.
Mientras el caos crece en otras partes, Esma y Garip saborean en silencio la alegría de un nuevo comienzo.
El amenazante ultimátum de Adem arrincona a Garip en una posición imposible.
Los instintos de Faruk vuelven a encenderse, confirmando las sospechas que ha llevado consigo durante semanas.
Una invitación inesperada de Reyhan obliga a Faruk a enfrentar su mayor miedo. Los recuerdos que durante años intentó enterrar resurgen, amenazando con desmoronar su compostura.
Cuando el reloj marca la medianoche y comienza el nuevo año, la mansión Boran parece tranquila por un breve instante… hasta que un secreto cae en las manos equivocadas.
Después de meses de tensión, comienza a formarse una frágil calidez entre Esma y Süreyya.

Every day with Barney is fun—but today is extra special. It's Barney's birthday!
Kami, one of Barney's youngest friends, has trouble keeping up with the other kids and she's tired of always being last. She's not having a very good day.
The kids have put together a Caboose Color Collection which showcases the primary colors—red, yellow and blue. Barney and Baby Bop enjoy songs and games suggested by the colorful objects.

The children are invited to a family picnic in the park, but don't know who invited them. The invitations instruct them to bring a family treasure, so each child has something special with them. Barney helps lead a discussion about families.
Barney, Baby Bop and the kids learn all about “on” and “off” by playing games together.

While Barney has fun with his friends every day, there's something special about making a brand NEW friend! When Mr. Boyd's niece, Colleen visits the park, she's eager to make friends with the other kids...but being the new kid isn't easy.

The children are surprised to learn that playing games and having fun in the park is great exercise. Baby Bop is happy to learn that not only is she exercising while she plays, but exercise will make her grow big and strong.
While Barney and the children wait for Mr. Boyd's new fountain to be delivered, they have fun playing in and exploring the park.

It's the day of the bike parade. But Nick has had a bike accident that leaves his bike in need of repair by Mr. Boyd. Barney helps Baby Bop and the children learn all about bicycles—and that they are a wonderful way to exercise and have fun.
When Miss Jo loses her cat, Barney and the children spend the day helping her find it. Along the way, they learn all about cats.
With a little Barney magic, the children experience the differences between day and night!
The children bring toys to donate to Mr. Boyd's toy drive. Baby Bop and BJ arrive and after some convincing, Baby Bop learns about the merits of sharing.

Barney and the kids are excited because five of Mr. Boyd's brass-playing buddies are putting on a show in the park tonight! Angela is learning to play the trumpet and knows that it takes a lot of practice. BJ arrives and the group visits the caboose.
Barney and his friends play hopscotch—with a twist. Whitney is learning about triangles at school, so Angela created Triangle Hopscotch to help reinforce triangles.

Barney and the kids help Mr. Boyd prepare his dog Bingo for a trip to the veterinarian for a check, while learning lessons about caring for dogs at the same time. Meanwhile, BJ is searching for his missing baseball, which he suspects was buried by Bingo.

p.t: David Bowie: On the Rock Trail
p.d: Some say that youth is wasted on the young, but this could never be said of Rock icon David Bowie. His distinctive music, exotic appearance and wild boy lifestyle defined an entire generation through the glamorous, hedonistic 1970s.

p.t: David Bowie: Out of This World
p.d: Few artists marked the 20th century like David Bowie did. He was an astonishing and eclectic performer. He was a true artist in every sense of the word. Infinitely changeable and unpredictable, he remains immortal in the people's heart.

Dolly Parton is the most honoured female country performer of all time. She has had 25 songs reach No1 on the Billboard Country charts, a record for female artists. She has 41 career top 10 country albums, a record for any artist.

p.t: David Bowie: The Man Who Stole the World
p.d: Today the world mourns one of the most iconic musical heroes, David Bowie. With the news of his passing flooding newspaper headlines and millions of fans paying tribute to him on social media, his departure has left a mark on many all over the world.
This documentary explores the making of a remarkable album: The Art of McCartney, features the finest artist of today paying their respect to the greatest.

Elvis Presley had a select group of friends he entrusted with his life. Through never seen before interviews, this documentary will explore Elvis’ life through the eyes of The Memphis Mafia, from the highs…To the lows.

p.t: Elvis Presley: From The Beginning To The End
p.d: A warm, moving and sensitive tribute and a comprehensive and detailed biography of Elvis' life.
The death of the King of Rock n Roll shocked the world. How did this happen? The true story of Elvis Presley's last hours on Earth is told by the men who knew him best, his Memphis Mafia.

p.t: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: De la broma a la guerra
p.d: La tablet manda a Ana e Isaac a una cita romántica y Leslie tambalea. La sala tornado abre sus puertas y sus vientos traen muchas dudas. Lizbeth y Diana planean una broma que no termina nada bien. La llegada del próximo ex podría ser devastadora.

p.t: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: El tiburón tiene colmillo
p.d: Los nuevos ex abren las puertas a más problemas. Diana se pone malacopa y amarga la fiesta más dulce. Un tiburón de dos patas visita la villa y lo que parecía un chiste termina siendo una verdadera amenaza. La primera Love Suite es para...

p.t: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: Shots con sentimiento
p.d: La llegada de Michelle hace arder la villa. La sala tornado pone de cabeza los sentimientos de Leslie. Christian inicia la llama del amor con Andrea mientras que Diana provoca una explosión.

p.t: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: No soportas, ¿verdad?
p.d: Lalo viene a terminar los pendientes con Leslie y a Isaac le toca atacarse. Lizbeth explota contra Isaac y Rufas. Yurgenis se libera en un catamarán, sin la sombra de Brandon. El nuevo ex llega muy salsa, pero de la que no pica.

p.t: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: El jaque mate
p.d: Ana saborea el plato de la venganza, mientras que Leslie se limpia las lágrimas con su orgullo. Un divertido día de playa se convierte en una pesadilla. La llegada del nuevo ex cambia el juego y La Divaza tira los dados cuando no es su turno.

p.t: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: Veo, veo y no veo claro
p.d: La Divaza decide quién debe abandonar la villa. Carolina no controla su ira y le desacomoda las extensiones a Yurgenis. Isaac respeta su condición y va por su próxima conquista. La tablet del terror desata una nueva oleada de discusiones.

p.t: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: Aquí se arma la de cantina

p.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 1
p.d: The baseball game with D'Arby continues within DIO's mansion. For some reason, Jotaro starts telling D'Arby what pitches he'll be throwing. D'Arby finds Jotaro's actions strange, but still believes he has the upper hand because of his Stand's abilities.

p.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 2
p.d: After a long, hard journey, the group is suddenly faced with saying goodbye to a friend. Polnareff can't control his emotions and starts brandishing his sword toward an unseen enemy with very little success.

p.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 3
p.d: Polnareff is pushed to his limits by Cool Ice's merciless attacks. As he awaits death, the dying Iggy manages to save him at the last minute. Polnareff then stabs Cool Ice in the head. Despite showing resilience to the attacks so far.

p.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: DIO's World, Part 1
p.d: Polnareff finally comes face-to-face with DIO. Despite Polnareff's hostility, DIO offers to forgive him and allow the Frenchman to join his side again. Polnareff refuses, but for some reason, he cannot get any closer to DIO.

p.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: DIO's World, Part 2
p.d: As night falls, the battle expands to encompass the whole city of Cairo. Amidst the melee, Kakyoin says he has a way to figure out DIO's Stand ability.

p.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: DIO's World, Part 3
p.d: Thanks to Kakyoin, Joseph is able to figure out that DIO's Stand, The World, has the power to stop time, but is quickly defeated by DIO. Jotaro then attacks The World with Star Platinum but is no match for DIO's power.

With help from Polnareff as well as putting his own life on the line, Jotaro is finally able to land a blow on DIO. Finding the shriveled body of Joseph Joestar, Jotaro becomes enraged and wages his final, desperate battle with DIO!

p.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Jotaro Kujo! Meets Josuke Higashikata
p.d: In April 1999, Jotaro Kujo travels to a town in Japan called Morioh to find a young man named Josuke Higashikata, the secret love child of his grandfather, Joseph Joestar. Upon finding him, Jotaro is surprised to learn that Josuke also possesses a Stand.

p.d: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.

p.t: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side
p.d: In terms of the Universe, we know we don't know much, especially when it comes to dark matter and dark energy. Scientists are devoting so much of their time to discovering as much as the possibly can about this mysterious matter.

p.t: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
p.d: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

p.t: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
p.d: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

p.t: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
p.d: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet- when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

p.t: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
p.d: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

Ash y Misty discuten sobre quién puede derrotar a un poderoso Entrenador y a su Poliwrath. Cuando él acepta ambos retos, la dura batalla que sigue le da a Misty algunas ideas sobre su propio Poliwhirl.

Tras oír sobre un parque de batallas cercano, Ash está ansioso por probar sus habilidades. Pero el trío del Equipo Rocket recientemente se unió al parque, y tienen algunas ideas para probar el temple de este Entrenador.

En las afueras de Ciudad Espina Negra, Ash conoce a la Líder de Gimnasio Clair, quien entrena a su Dratini para una ceremonia. Pero el Equipo Rocket tiene otros planes para el tipo Dragón, y Ash y Clair deben detenerlos.

Al enfrentarse a Clair, Líder del Gimnasio Espina Negra, Ash tiene dificultades para vencer a su Pokémon tipo Dragón. Todo se complica cuando el Equipo Rocket intenta robar la reliquia de Colmillo de Dragón de la ciudad.

El Equipo Rocket ha tomado el Colmillo de Dragón de Ciudad Espina Negra y se ha adentrado a fondo en la guarida del Dragón. Todo parece ir mal para la antigua reliquia, pero la ayuda llega de un viejo amigo.
¡Ash y Clair finalmente se enfrentan en una batalla de Gimnasio que llevará las habilidades de Entrenador de Ash hasta el límite! ¿Podrá ganar su última medalla de Gimnasio en Johto?

Un truco del Equipo Rocket le arrebata a Ash todas sus medallas de Gimnasio de Johto duramente ganadas, pero pronto, el problemático trío recibe una lección. ¿Qué astuto Pokémon los habrá vencido en su propio juego?
Al descubrir un equipo de nado sincronizado Pokémon, Misty va a verlo y pronto se encuentra yendo bajo la superficie para enfrentar al entrenador del Equipo en una emocionante batalla bajo el agua.

Ash acaba de llegar a Pueblo New Bark cuando sale a recuperar un Huevo Pokémon para el Profesor Elm. Sin embargo, las cosas se ponen interesantes cuando encuentra a un viejo amigo, y el Equipo Rocket aparece con más trucos.

Mysterious disappearances, brutal attacks, wounded people leaving trails of blood. Can a ruthless predator fish with razor-sharp teeth like the piranha, with its reputation as a true man eater, really be responsible?
Cyril's attention is captured by videos of two huge, unidentified creatures appearing off of Florida's coast - and discovering what these monsters are becomes an obsession. Is it even a fish?

Back in the Ruby Valley, Jake tracks a dangerous mother lion and her young.
Jake's second mountain lion chase in the Ruby Valley leaves him cliffed out; Eustace and Raleigh turn scrap steel into pure profit; Kidd sets off on a whitewater excursion unlike any other.

Kidd and Harry are sent into a dangerous free fall by a freak ATV accident; Jake goes on ranch patrol to protect newborn calves; Nancy gives Tom the surprise of a lifetime; Josh attempts to wrangle a feral horse.
The expedition attempts a 100 mile open water crossing in the Bering Sea. Charles nears hypothermia. Fall approaches and the and the men fear they may never reach the Bering Strait.

Steven uses every resource available to get the expedition to Nome Alaska. Steven develops a high fever and the team goes to work without their leader. The men see Herds of Caribou along the shore and end up camping on the edge of the world.

It’s a quiet morning as the expedition face their final day and attempt to cross the Bering Strait. The men try to get fuel from the small native village of Wales. The seas turn huge and the men face their worst fears.

The men return to the Bering Strait nine months after their first failed attempt to cross into Russian waters. Excitement builds but the weather will not cooperate so the men take refuge in the small native settlement of Wales and wait for their window.

Bogart finally snaps when Paul buys yet another lousy locker at an auction in Toronto’s Liberty Village.
Life changes dramatically for nearly all the buyers at an auction in Toronto. Except for Roy, who’s still a jerk.

Roy hires bodyguards to keep the riff-raff away at an auction in Brampton. Bogart quits, but just when he thinks he's out can Paul pull him back in? Rick and Cindy make a wicked-awesome discovery, and Ursula gets carried away.

Roy's arch-nemesis, auctioneer Patrick Pecker, calls an auction on Weston Road. While Roy seeks to lift the curse, Ursula works her charm. Meanwhile, Bogart reads Paul the riot-shirt, and Rick and Cindy get lost.

Ursula's new employee Tania is tough, goth, and not afraid to pick fights at auctions in Toronto. Of course, Cindy isn't about to back down. When Bogart decides to assert himself, he threatens Roy's claim to the title of biggest jerk at the auction.

Part-time janitors Mike and Armando hope to clean up at an auction in Emery Village. Rick and Cindy don't want more newbies but Paul is always looking out to replace Bogart. Roy can't handle the tooth but Ursula's locker is totally tubular.

New, hard evidence suggests that Fred Nolan's theory that a ship was buried in the swamp centuries ago, may be true.
The team may be closer than ever to shutting down the flood tunnels when they discover large amounts of coconut fiber in the uplands.
The fellowship of the dig doubles down on their efforts in the swamp and discover that it might hold the key to solving the entire Oak Island mystery as Fred Nolan predicted.
Allen and Ton trek to an auction in Moreno Valley, CA, where two locker wins yield a vintage jukebox, a valuable baseball card, and a Prohibition-era moonshine still.
Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun, and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

Archer must choose between the safety of his crew and doing the right thing as the vulnerable Enterprise must survive while trying to uphold justice between two different unknown alien ships in battle.

An Enterprise away-team fights delusions and paranoid suspicions caused by an alien wildflower's hallucinogenic pollen while stranded overnight to wait out a violent windstorm on a beautiful unexplored planet.
While attempting to repair the warp engine of an alien ship, Trip inadvertently becomes impregnated and the Enterprise must relocate the ship before the baby is due.

The first to see the lost human colony of Terra Nova in over seventy-five years, Archer and the Enterprise crew discover the original colonists descendants have evolved into an underground race called Novans.

Archer, Trip and T'Pol make first contact with the suspicious and militaristic Andorians while helping to reveal the secrets within the ancient Vulcan monastery of P'Jem, uncovering a major violation of the Andorian/Vulcan Peace Treaty
Archer attempts a little diplomacy with a very unwelcoming Vulcan Captain. Reed and Mayweather are in danger while drilling for samples on an uncharted massive comet.
Discovering their first alien civilization, Archer and the crew unfortunately also find a ship of invasive alien miners who are carelessly causing thousands of innocent deaths upon the planet.

In attempting to aid the damaged Earth freighter Fortunate, the Enterprise finds itself caught in the middle of a cold-blooded revenge plot. Mayweather uses his past to ultimately resolve the heated conflict

While the Enterprise witnesses a religious stellar occurrence, Archer finds himself again faced against the Suliban warrior Silik, while allied with a Temporal soldier from the future sent to prevent Silik from changing the course of history.
Faced with defending themselves against a powerful, unidentified alien vessel, Trip and Reed frantically work to install the massive phase cannons into the Enterprise before the vessel returns.

After discovering that an alien race is slowly becoming extinct due to a genetic disease, Archer and Dr. Phlox struggle with the decision of whether to interfere by saving the species or to let nature make its own choices.
While investigating a strange Klingon vessel, T'Pol, Reed and Hoshi become stranded when a Klingon female escapes the disabled ship in their shuttlepod.
T'Pol is blamed for the Andorian destruction of the sanctuary of P'Jem, and is therefore removed of her position onboard the Enterprise.

After returning to where they left the Enterprise and finding only the scattered remains of their ship, Trip and Reed struggle to survive and hope for rescue with only a few days worth of oxygen left inside Shuttlepod One.

p.t: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
p.d: 23rd century: the Federation Starship U.S.S. Enterprise™ is on routine training maneuvers, and Admiral James T. Kirk seems resigned to the fact that this inspection may well be the last space mission of his career. But Khan is back...

p.t: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
p.d: Admiral Kirk’s defeat of Khan and the creation of the Genesis planet are empty victories. Spock is dead and McCoy is inexplicably being driven insane. Then a surprise visit from Sarek, Spock’s father, provides a startling revelation.

p.t: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
p.d: It’s the 23rd century and an alien power is evaporating the oceans. To save mankind, Kirk and his crew must time travel back to 1986 where they find a world of punk, pizza and exact-change buses that are as alien as anything they’ve ever encountered.

p.t: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
p.d: Captain Kirk and his crew must deal with Mr. Spock's long-lost half-brother, who hijacks the Enterprise for an obsessive search for God at the center of the galaxy.

p.t: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
p.d: After years of war, the Federation and the Klingon empire find themselves on the brink of a peace summit when a Klingon ship is nearly destroyed by an apparent attack from the Enterprise. Both worlds brace for what may be their deadliest encounter.

Sarita y Franco pelean de nuevo, esta vez delante de todos los invitados a la fiesta en honor a los Reyes. Juan muere de celos al ver a Fernando con Gabriela, teme que Norma haya vuelto con él.
Juan conoce a su hijo y lo toma en sus brazos con ternura, Gabriela arma un escándalo hasta que Norma aclara que él tiene derechos porque es el padre, luego ella desacata la orden de su madre.
Fernando acepta la propuesta de trabajo de Gabriela, Norma accede, aunque exige que no se inmiscuya en su vida, ella está dispuesta a enfrentar a su madre por Juan. Rosario pregunta por Franco.
Juan le da un regalo a su hijo cuando vuelve a encontrarse con Norma en los límites de la hacienda, ella no esconde sus sentimientos. Ruth desafía a su madre y comienza a trabajar con Leandro.
Norma descubre que su bebé no tiene la cadena que le regaló Juan y se enfrenta con Gabriela, mientras que Martín le aconseja que vuelva con el padre de su hijo. Armando se enfurece con Rosario.
Fernando asume el cargo de administrador de la hacienda Elizondo, tanto Norma como Juan desconfían de sus intenciones. Óscar pide ser el galán del comercial de Jimena y Rosario busca a Franco.
Juan quiere que sus hermanos conozcan a su hijo, Norma no se opone y tiene una dura discusión con Gabriela. En la filmación del comercial, Jimena ve que el galán es Óscar, él la secuestra.
Norma decide bautizar al bebé y le dice a Juan que se llamará Juan David, después del bautizo él le presenta su hijo a todos los empleados. Gabriela interroga a Fernando sobre Dínora.
Martín le aconseja a Norma que se case con Juan, quien sueña vivir con ella y el niño como una familia. Rosario se le atraviesa con el carro a Franco y él la rechaza, Gabriela pacta con Dínora.
Rosario se propone reconquistar a Franco, lo que ella no sabe es que Armando piensa en acabar con él en la fiesta. A las hijas y al padre de Gabriela les extraña su nueva amistad con Dínora.
En la fiesta, Franco cubre a Sara con piropos y la acompaña al carro, ella ve cuando lo secuestran. Jimena coquetea con un invitado para darle celos a Óscar mientras Norma confronta a su madre.
Sara arriesga su vida para salvar a Franco de los matones, él le agradece con un beso. Jimena llega a la casa tras burlarse de Óscar y se preocupa por su hermana, a ambas les espera un regaño.
Norma acude a su cita con Juan, pero se va al ver que no está solo, Óscar enfrenta a Jimena delante de Gabriela, quien se indigna al saber lo sucedido. Franco busca desquitarse de los matones.
Dínora le inventa a Norma que es novia de Juan, él no se queda tranquilo, busca a la madre de su hijo y trata de aclarar todo cuando otra mentira los separa. Franco pone a Armando en su sitio.
